meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源限制并输出JSON快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解本地机器资源限制后再运行任务
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resource limits and output JSON snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know your local machine's resource limits before running tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在做大数据分析、模型训练等重计算任务前,会先检测你电脑的可用资源,生成一个资源报告文件,并给出并行计算、GPU 加速或省内存策略的建议。
howto.when: 当你说要分析大数据、训练模型、批量处理文件等重计算任务,或直接问'我该用什么计算策略'时,Claude 会先检查本机资源再答复。

say.text: 我要分析一个50GB的基因组数据,怎么做?
say.note: 它会先检测内存和磁盘,再建议是否用 Dask。

say.text: 帮我训练神经网络,先查有没有可用 GPU。
say.note: 它会检测 GPU 类型并推荐加速库。

say.text: 有一万个小文件要并行处理,给个并行数建议。
say.note: 它会按 CPU 核数推荐 worker 数量。

howto.what_en: After installation, before heavy tasks like large data analysis or model training, Claude checks your machine's resources, writes a JSON snapshot, and suggests parallel processing, GPU acceleration, or memory-saving strategies.
howto.when_en: When you ask to analyze large data, train a model, run batch file processing, or ask which compute strategy to use, Claude first checks local resources before answering.

say_en.text: I need to analyze a 50GB genomics dataset. How should I proceed?
say_en.note: It first checks memory and disk, then suggests whether to use Dask.

say_en.text: Help me train a neural network. Check if a GPU is available first.
say_en.note: It detects the GPU type and recommends an acceleration library.

say_en.text: I have 10,000 small files to process in parallel. Suggest a worker count.
say_en.note: It recommends workers based on CPU cores.
